name: Bitter bamboo shoot
summary: Vietnam Airlines calls măng đắng a forest specialty: a fresh shoot, slightly bitter, eaten with a dip or stir-fried with forest pork. Tạp chí Sở hữu trí tuệ also names it at Thác Hiêu. It is not măng rừng and not măng khô.
origin: Vietnam Airlines travel guide for Pù Luông. Tạp chí Sở hữu trí tuệ, 12 Jul 2024, lists it among Thai-Muong dishes of Thác Hiêu.
taste: Vietnam Airlines says the fresh shoot is slightly bitter.
howToEat: With a special dip, or stir-fried with forest pork, on Vietnam Airlines. The dip is not given a recipe there. Check on arrival.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: The valley table Vietnam Airlines describes, and Thác Hiêu on the 12 Jul 2024 list. A door was not printed.
seoTitle: Bitter bamboo shoot in Pu Luong — dip or forest pork
seoDescription: Măng đắng is the slightly bitter shoot Vietnam Airlines serves with a dip or forest pork. It stays apart from măng rừng. The price is Check on arrival.
